trigger: First funded primary support-family failure, followed by one optional strict fee-net worst-supported-wealth-improving mitigation and absorbing human Review.
customer_text: Your portfolio’s risk buffer no longer supports our usual trading options. We make a protective trade only if the modeled worst outcome improves after costs, then pause automated trading for human review. Existing holdings remain invested and may continue losing value.
explanation: Usual trading options refers to the declared finite family, not all possible portfolios. Protective trade is conditional; absent strict modeled improvement the account holds. Pending existing exposures remain invested and can lose value. This is technical product text, not paper drafting.
